The cell timed out. Let me run just a single SCF step first to gauge cost/feasibility.

```python
import sys, time, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages')
from pyscf import gto, scf

atoms = [('C',[0.0,0.0,0.0]),('O',[1.43,0.0,0.0]),
         ('H',[-0.54,0.96,0.0]),('H',[-0.54,-0.96,0.0]),
         ('H',[1.8,0.9,0.0]),('H',[2.0,-0.7,0.0])]
t=time.time()
mol = gto.M(atom=atoms, basis='sto-3g', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
mf = scf.RHF(mol)
e = mf.kernel()
print("E = %.8f  converged=%s  time=%.2fs" % (e, mf.converged, time.time()-t))
```
